question: Should this fail-closed mutation-boundary and credential-renewal rollout land now as the authoritative repair write contract?
rationale: The patch is technically clean, but it changes the final authorization boundary for closes, merges, comments, labels, and durable state publication, so a member must explicitly own the intended fail-closed availability tradeoff.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Finalize the draft and merge after confirming the current green head, accepting blocked retries as the intended response to drift or unknown outcomes.

options.title: Stage a narrower rollout
options.body: Land only selected mutation phases first and keep the remaining apply or post-flight writes on the existing contract until additional operational proof is collected.

options.title: Pause the boundary change
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers are not ready to make receipt-backed fail-closed behavior the repair lane's authoritative contract.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
recommendation.body: Finalize the draft and merge after confirming the current green head, accepting blocked retries as the intended response to drift or unknown outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: They own both the merged cursor prerequisite and this branch's repair mutation implementation, tests, and workflow sequencing.
